classification: Simplified source-derived explanatory previews; not native SysML graphical views.
authority: Existing published synthetic demonstration models, ledgers, evidence and actual checker outputs. No model or evidence semantics changed.
scope: Eight new preview families plus links to the preserved existing overview. No new UI, ports, topology, allocations, control flow, decisions or thresholds.
source_root: examples/engineering-gallery/water-sampling unless a repository-relative path is explicitly given.

views.question: What happens during a normal pickup?
views.prompt: Show the four normal sample handoffs, naming who sends what to whom. Use the existing station model and distinguish documentary exchanges from executable behavior.
views.meaning_boundary: Four ordered message rows; manual/protocol handoffs, no inferred timing or activity control flow.
views.display_title: How does a normal handoff work?

views.question: What happens when a label cannot be read?
views.prompt: Walk through the unreadable-label hold and recovery. Show the four existing exchanges and make the unreleased hold explicit.
views.meaning_boundary: An exception/recovery reading, not a station UI or an accepted reconciliation policy.
views.display_title: How does an unreadable label get resolved?

views.question: Who is responsible for each action?
views.prompt: Show the recorded responsibilities for identifying, recording, reconciling and inspecting samples. Keep participants distinct from functions and expose missing allocations.
views.meaning_boundary: Five selected documentary allocations of twelve; courier is a sequence participant with no function allocation recorded. No native allocation or feasibility proof.

views.question: Which needs and scenarios connect to each check?
views.prompt: Read the existing need, requirement and scenario traces. Preserve link direction and kind, and show any missing scenario link without inventing one.
views.meaning_boundary: All six recorded typed links; a link records a relationship, not satisfaction.
views.display_title: Which need does each check support?

views.question: Did each container receive its own receipt in time?
views.prompt: Compare the existing passing and late receipt traces. Show overlapping container IDs, the inclusive two-second deadline and the correctly reversed response order.
views.meaning_boundary: Actual supported correlated-event monitor outputs for wholly synthetic traces. No latency distribution, implementation behavior or physical validation.
views.display_title: Did each receipt arrive in time?

views.question: Was the observed processing duration within its limit?
views.prompt: Compare the recorded-receipt observations of four and five seconds against the fictional four-second limit. Show which check fails and retain the other passing controls.
views.meaning_boundary: Observed integer ticks, not an inferred elapsed clock. Both values are valid within declared 0..20; only the receipt-time quantity clause fails for 5.
views.display_title: Is the recorded duration within its limit?

views.question: Why can this deliberately broken handoff never finish?
views.prompt: Explain the existing blocked-handoff negative control. Show the contradictory guard and the actual finite verifier findings without implying a SysML-to-executable conversion.
views.meaning_boundary: Reproduce the exact existing contradictory-guard mutation; original finite fixture stays unchanged. State connectivity differs from guard-enabled reachability.

views.question: How could we compare two useful alternatives?
views.prompt: Compare the existing community tool-library paper and laptop concepts. Show the conditional capacity arithmetic and evidence gaps without selecting a winner or predicting wait time.
views.meaning_boundary: Legacy version 1 concept comparison. Conditional arithmetic from fictional recollections; no measured candidate advantage, expected wait, accepted weights or final selection.

presentation_readings.K_PAPER: Private loan record; separate public tools/status board. Handover updates both.
presentation_readings.K_LAPTOP: Record each handover once; derive a separate tools/status view from the same data.

geometry_policy: 800px natural width; source-derived labels at 22px, supporting text 18px or larger. Narrow offline views scroll, never scale formal content to fit. Plain-language aliases retain precise source IDs in the ledger and nearby links.
